anna: Quick town-hall follow-up — appreciate the turnout. Highlights: new Dedicated partner wave, trial retention defaults tightened, and SLO playbook pilots launching. Recording + short notes below.

harry: recording + slides: https://redwood.cloud/recordings/2156789999-townhall.mp4 and https://drive.redwood/company/allhands/2156789999-slides.pdf

lee: quick summary: priority to existing enterprise pilots, then invite list for GA early access. ops to email invites next week. see slide 6 for full criteria.

ops_bot: Transcript ready: https://redwood.cloud/transcripts/2156789999.txt. Follow-ups doc created: https://docs.redwood/company/allhands/2156789999-followups

sophia: thanks  also, retention policy question: does the change affect demo orgs or just trials?

harry: marketing ask: can product provide 2-3 bullet points we can use externally? I can carve them into a short blog and social posts.

anna: suggested bullets (from product): 1) Dedicated partner wave expands reserved capacity and region pinning; 2) Trials default to shorter retention for non-PII to reduce risk; 3) SLO playbooks to standardize on-call readiness across teams.

sophia: tagging security/legal for any outstanding compliance Qs.

ops_bot: Action owners added to follow-ups doc: product (harry) to draft public copy by Tue, ops (lee) to send Dedicated invites, legal to confirm EU language by Fri.

lee: I'll schedule the SLO kickoff next Wed 9am PT and invite reps. Please nominate one person from each team by EOD Friday.

anna: thanks everyone. If you weren't able to attend, watch the recording and add any follow-ups to the doc. We'll do a short update in #product after the kickoff.

harry: noted. I'll post the public blurb draft here when ready.

sophia: :thumbsup: closing loop.
